stories.title: 2026 FC 100: Kane, Yamal, Messi among best men's soccer players
stories.summary: Before the 2026-27 season kicks off across Europe this weekend, it's time to rank the top 100 players in the world of men's soccer, including those who starred at the World Cup this summer. Welcome to the FC 100.

stories.title: Padres minor league coordinator detained by ICE
stories.summary: Oswaldo Pirela, the minor league catching coordinator for the Padres, was detained by ICE at the El Paso International Airport early Sunday.

stories.title: Goodell: 'No doubt' over NFL team outside U.S.
stories.summary: Roger Goodell said it is inevitable that the NFL will eventually have a team permanently based outside the United States.

stories.title: Knicks title 'embarrassing' to Nets, owner says
stories.summary: Nets owner Joe Tsai admitted in a recent interview that the Knicks' title run is "embarrassing" to his franchise.

stories.title: Jets' Hall out 2-3 weeks, expected to play opener
stories.summary: Jets starting running back Breece Hall will miss two to three weeks with a groin strain but is expected to be "ready for the regular season," coach Aaron Glenn said Tuesday.
